tasks.goal: Guide visitors along the charter exhibits, gesturing at each charter pillar and narrating the DAO's mission and human-reserved governance actions.
tasks.terrain: Indoor concrete plaza floor with low exhibit plinths and cable ramps; flat, wheelchair-accessible routes.
success: Visits all 5 charter exhibits within 10 min
Visitors remain within 1.5 m during narration
safety_stops: E-stop on contact force >5 N
Stop if visitor closer than 0.3 m
Battery below 15% returns to dock
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the tour script wording before public delivery.

tasks.goal: Retrieve printed research briefs from the printer station and deliver them to each synthesis desk, announcing arrival at each.
tasks.terrain: Lab aisle with tiled floor, under-desk clearance 0.35 m, loose papers and chairs as dynamic obstacles.
success: Delivers to correct desk per queue order
safety_stops: Stop on torso contact
Pause if aisle blocked >10 s
Release grip and stop if load shifts >15 deg
tasks.human_in_loop: A researcher confirms the delivery queue contents at shift start.

tasks.goal: Carry a roving microphone dock to whichever speaker holds the floor during proposal debate, tracking debate state transitions.
tasks.terrain: Open forum floor with riser steps (<=0.2 m), standing audience clusters and cable runs from the AV rack.
success: Arrives within 1 m of active speaker in <8 s
Maintains >=1 m clearance from seated humans
safety_stops: Sit down on detected trip hazard
Stop if human within 0.8 m at speed >0.5 m/s
Return to dock on comms loss >5 s
tasks.human_in_loop: The moderator (a person) validates each speaker-of-floor transition before Spot moves.

tasks.goal: Patrol the observatory's outdoor perimeter trail above the Arroyo Seco, logging terrain conditions and reading outcome-display QR panels.
tasks.terrain: Compacted dirt trail through chaparral margins: loose gravel, seasonal dry washes, slopes to 15 deg, low scrub encroachment.
safety_stops: Stop on roll-tilt >20 deg
Halt if wash crossing shows standing water
Remote e-stop on trail user detection <5 m
tasks.human_in_loop: An operator approves route start each day and reviews flagged terrain anomalies.

tasks.goal: Sort task-routing tokens and spare electronics into labeled working-group bins on the operations kitting table.
tasks.terrain: Fixed kitting table, ESD mats, bin walls 0.1 m high; mixed rigid and cable-like items on the table surface.
success: Zero bin mix-ups between adjacent groups
safety_stops: Stop on external force >40 N
Stop if hand enters workspace volume
Slow mode within 0.5 m of table edge
tasks.human_in_loop: A working-group lead approves the bin-assignment map before each kitting run.

tasks.goal: Fly a 3-drone swarm inside the observatory dome to capture a live occupancy map and progress-display overview for stewards.
tasks.terrain: Dome interior: smooth floor launch pads, catwalk railings as ceiling obstacles, exhibit towers to 4 m, mild HVAC drafts.
success: >=90% coverage of dome volume in 8 min
Map drift <0.2 m vs motion capture
safety_stops: Land immediately on positioning error >0.3 m
Battery <20% triggers return-to-pad
Cease flight if a person enters the dome floor
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward clears the dome of people and authorizes each swarm flight.

tasks.goal: Calibrate joint torque sensors and end-effector repeatability on the lab bench using a fixed calibration plate, recording drift for the synthesis agents.
tasks.terrain: Bolted lab bench with calibration grid plate, cable umbilical within workspace, adjacent monitor arm as pinch hazard.
success: Torque residual <0.05 Nm on all 7 joints
No contact force >10 N on plate
safety_stops: Reflex stop on any unexpected contact
Stop if umbilical tension exceeds limit
Disable on operator console e-stop
tasks.human_in_loop: A lab technician verifies and signs off the calibration report before robots resume experiments.
